build_encrypted_rtp_packet: build a NaCl-encrypted RTP packet matching Discord's format with a given secret key and opus payload
test_voice_receiver_decrypt: test the VoiceReceiver decrypts real NaCl-encrypted RTP packets and buffers audio data
test_rtp_padding_strip: test the VoiceReceiver strips RFC 3550 RTP padding before DAVE or Opus decode
test_voice_silence_detection: test the VoiceReceiver detects silence and returns completed utterances with user IDs
test_auth_filtering: test the VoiceReceiver filters audio to only process allowed users and auto-maps SSRCs
